title: driver state.json
description: Single source of truth for one driver cycle, at .plan/<slug>/state.json. Initial skeleton written by the driver, filled by preplan, read+updated by every phase. Append/merge only — never delete.

finding.description: shared finding shape for audit/review rounds

evidence_ref.description: path to the full evidence file under .plan/ (never inline evidence in state)

issue_id.description: Slug. From a Linear key, or user-chosen. Validate against the pattern BEFORE using it in any path (path traversal).

ref.description: issue key, file path, or slug

spec_file.description: .plan/<slug>/spec.md — source=prompt, and source=linear (full issue body with local attachment links, G-23)

attachments.description: per-attachment download results for linear sources (G-23), recorded by preplan/plan via save-linear-attachments.py

url.description: original remote URL (empty string for unparseable <linear-image> blocks)

local.description: local relative path (attachments/<name>) when downloaded or already present

status.description: downloaded = saved under .plan/<slug>/attachments/; skipped = host not allowed / already exists / unparseable; failed = download error

error.description: download error message (failed) or skip reason (skipped), e.g. exists|host-not-allowed|unparseable

branch.description: branch the cycle runs on (feat/<slug> created on protected branches)

remote.description: Filled by preplan: origin remote + detected forge. The forge is cached repo-locally in `git config driver.forge` (see SKILL.md §7.1); the pr phase picks its CLI from `forge`/`cli`.

host.description: host parsed from the https/ssh remote URL

cli.description: fj = forgejo-cli, whichever binary name exists

source.description: flag = --forge flag (persisted to git config); cache = git config driver.forge; probe = detected this run

skip.description: --skip: phases marked skipped and never spawned (incl. per-task gate spawns). Mutually exclusive with params.phases. On a fresh run preplan/plan may not be skipped; --force never un-skips

qa_scope.description: --qa-scope: per-task (scope=task) quality-gate runs the task's manifest qa.command ("scoped") or the full state.qa.command ("full"); the cycle-scope run always runs state.qa.command

force.description: re-run requested phases even if done

draft.description: --draft: open the PR/MR as a draft (pr phase)

forge.description: --forge: override forge detection for the pr phase; a concrete value is persisted to `git config driver.forge` by preplan. auto = detect from the origin remote (cached) — see SKILL.md §7.1

variants.description: phase -> variant name, e.g. { plan: "thorough" }; resolved via the driver's VARIANTS table

summary.description: SHORT (a few lines) — big content lives in .plan/ files

assumptions.description: explicit assumptions recorded by the plan phase (mirror of plan.md ## Assumptions); surfaced at the driver's plan-approval gate

open_questions.description: open questions from the plan phase (mirror of plan.md); listed in the phase summary

audit.description: per-task spec-audit verdict (scope=task). A task is done only with commit + audit pass + qa pass/skipped

implement.description: one entry per driver/implement spawn (task mode or fix mode); phases.implement stays the aggregate status

scope.description: fix mode only: which gate the repair belongs to

fix_target.description: fix mode only: which state list the fix is recorded under

commit.description: SHA of the commit this spawn produced

verdict.description: fail iff any finding with status=fail has severity blocker or major; minor/nit failures are warnings, not failures

scope.description: task = verify one task's criteria right after its commit; cycle = end-of-cycle pass over everything

fixes.description: repair commits spawned by the driver in fix mode

verdict.description: fail iff any finding has severity blocker or major; minor/nit are warnings, not failures

fixes.description: repair commits spawned by the driver in fix mode

log.description: path to full log under .plan/, e.g. .plan/ABC-123/qa.log

log_excerpt.description: short tail of the log kept inline in state; the full log lives at qa.log

runs.description: per-task (scope=task) quality-gate runs; the cycle-scope run stays in the top-level qa fields

command.description: command actually run (task qa.command or state.qa.command)

verdict.description: skipped when qa_scope=scoped and the task declares no qa.command

fixes.description: repair commits spawned by the driver for quality-gate failures

module.description: module name = module dir relative to the repo root (e.g. module1, src/core); "root" for repo-root-level changes

agent_dir.description: module dir holding the .agent/ folder ("." for the repo root); added in G-22 — additive extension, no field removed

history_file.description: <agent_dir>/.agent/history.md (G-22: per-module .agent/ folder; previously the root-level agent/ path)

decision_file.description: <agent_dir>/.agent/decisions.md when real decisions were recorded, else null

forge.description: forge the PR/MR was opened on

report.description: path to the final run report, .plan/<slug>/report.md, written by the driver at cycle end

session_id.description: ID of the OpenCode session that started the run; written by the driver at skeleton creation (agents/driver.md step 5) via the built-in opencode.session_move no-op; null on older OpenCode without the tool; used by driver-viz for session-scoped run filtering
